'''Flare Base''' was an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] military base on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Korseg IV]]. It was located high in the mountains. The base was understaffed with only 200 personnel, half a dozen [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wings]], and a medium [[Transport/Legends|transport]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the base came under [[Battle of Korseg IV|attack]] from [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces and had to be evacuated.<ref name="'RPG2ERE" />

==Behind the scenes==
Flare Base was mentioned in [[West End Games]]'[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game, Second Edition|''Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game'', Second Edition]], released in [[1992]].<ref name="'RPG2E">[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game, Second Edition|''Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game'', Second Edition]]</ref>
